title: [review] messaging.py:159: Registrar callback can mutate
description: Lines 159-160: _sent_detail_registrar receives the same body dict reference that is then passed to deliver(). If the registrar mutates body, those mutations appear in the delivered inbox message. The _sent copy (line 150) uses deepcopy so it's isolated, but inbox receives the mutated version. Consider passing a copy to the registrar or to deliver.
